title: A coordinator pick reaches the page as an item the owner can overrule
why:
Owner 12:08 CST Nov 12 (coordinator relay 12:10 CST): he cannot see coordinator picks anywhere to overrule them. Owner 00:11 CST Nov 15 asked again where they went; consultant 00:17 CST Nov 15 (consultant's reading, undoable): fill Pick stands with the picks sessions take for him. Read 00:17 CST Nov 15: Pick stands holds 54 stands items, none open; the newest dates 11:37 CST Nov 13; each stands item is about 2 KB. Six session picks since then are filed only as rulings: coord-836-b-one-wait-per-ready-pr, coord-837-d-send-later-session-waits (both 20:20 CST Nov 14), coord-debt-close-route-a (21:23 CST Nov 14), own-791-2-narrow-revert-first (20:34 CST Nov 14), and the coordinator picks noted in own-830-c-ci-scope-green-before-head (17:15 CST Nov 14) and own-820-c-five-repos (00:32 CST Nov 14). Not posted: the page contract (skill waiting-page, step 2 of Add an item; page.html standsOk) sets stands only on a decision that changes no rule, and each of these changes a rule, hook or merge-tool behaviour; a stood pick goes with the owner's next Send, so posting would ratify a rule by one tap. ORDINARY-ITEM ROUTE 00:23 CST Nov 15 (consultant's pick a, 00:20 CST, its reading under the owner's 20:18 words, not owner-typed): triage posts each session-taken pick as an ordinary open item "taken for you: <pick>; overrule?" with Keep and Overrule, not as `stands`. Posted items 853 to 857 (836 b, 837 d, debt-close route A, 791 pick 2, the narrower build of 830 c), 13,179 bytes read back; item 821 already put 820 c's inside pick to the owner, and 852 and 328 were his own items, so none for those. The page contract is unchanged; a durable rule that every pick reaches the page this way is still the guard #2870.

Lane started 00:22 CST Nov 15 under own-draft-rebase-lanes (draft PR #2870); lane session_013NEJL3DdpyeubY4GXaMnPL read running and connected by get_session. Replaced lane field session_013NEJL4M2MdWXUDjYUVC9Cf.

02:09 CST Nov 15: the lane pushed d265f930 (glossary fix after its lane lint failed) to its draft; it asked whether own-draft-rebase-lanes covered it (a lane-lint fix is not literally a review-round fix). Consultant 02:10 CST: yes, and the ruling is widened to any plain push fixing a finding of review, lane lint, fix check or CI on the lane's own draft (consultant's pick, not owner-typed; see ruling own-draft-rebase-lanes). The lane may keep d265f930.

note: A check that a coordinator message saying "coordinator pick" has a matching item on the page with `stands: true` (section Pick stands). Extend the home of steps c102 (an undoable pick is taken, not asked; the Stop reply judge) and c118 (a decision always reaches a clickable pick), both done, before a new home. Red first on today's case: 19 picks on Nov 12 with no page item until 12:13 CST. Shape (coordinator 12:10 CST): a check, not a note. A send_message from a cs-build:coordinator session whose text names "coordinator pick" is refused unless the same turn also sent triage the pick, or the message goes to triage. Mistake: 19 picks on Nov 12 reached no page (owner 12:08 CST); owner 12:09 CST: "this needs to be mechanized". Owner asked at 10:54 why coordinator picks stopped reaching the page: this guard (#2870, built Nov 12) sat with no review record and an idle lane, one of the lost PRs. Carried by: triage 11 (18:55 CST Nov 18, consultant 18:55 CST), as the send check of step page-taken-picks-area. REST/session read 18:55 CST: PR 2870 is still an open draft (head d265f930be, last update Nov 15); its lane session_013NEJL1J8PbpBBHCYyXXDSM is archived (16 Nov) and its last report called this step void after PR 3472 removed Pick stands. The guard's remedy text still says 'stands item'; the check now means a coordinator pick reaches the page as a taken-pick card.
